- Note 2 (Security): employment type contractor, security training basic, role Engineer, recommends read. Says Security DB shows contractor with basic training, max read; write requires advanced training. Requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.

The security note says the security record takes precedence over HR note regarding employment type. So the employee is a contractor with basic security training.

Policy: contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

Morgan is a contractor with basic training, so maximum is read. Requested write > max read, so grant read.

Evidence: Security record indicates contractor with basic security training, max read. Requested write exceeds max, so grant read.

Submit decision: read.
